reason: The hypothesis synthesizes separate observations of oxide disruption during wear (P2) and micro-galvanic corrosion in dual-phase HEAs (P18, P21, P26, P32) into a single feedback loop that links mechanical oxide removal at phase boundaries to accelerated electrochemical attack, an integrated mechanism not stated in any single passage. It also proposes a controlled comparison using a homogenized baseline to isolate the role of phase-boundary heterogeneity, which goes beyond the reported studies.
